title: Technology building blocks
why: Understand how AI connects to software and becomes a working application.

images.headline: Technology building blocks
images.prompt:
Create ONE finished premium educational presentation slide image, strictly landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. This is part of a matched 100-concept Data Science Masterminds Agentic Accelerator V3 APEX series. Style: Apple-inspired restraint, polished friendly 3D objects with subtle realistic studio lighting, generous negative space, deep navy background #041B36 fading very subtly to near-black #020B18, white text #F7F8FC, restrained amber #F2A541 emphasis and teal #5EC4B6 secondary details. No excessive glow, no clutter, no stock-photo collage, no Apple logos. Typography Space Grotesk-like modern clean headings and Inter-like body.
